event_records.description: Nimbus Freight's tracking portal goes down.

communications_lead.name: Communications Lead
communications_lead.persona_brief:
You are Communications Lead.
The communications lead is at an offsite all morning and may not be reachable. They are responsible for sending customer incident notices per the runbook.

nimbus_freight_as_decision_making_entity.name: Nimbus Freight (as decision-making entity)
nimbus_freight_as_decision_making_entity.persona_brief:
You are Nimbus Freight (as decision-making entity).
Nimbus Freight's incident runbook requires customer email within four hours of outage start (by 10:00). The status page already acknowledges the outage. The company can decide to send the notice via other staff or escalate.

resolution.question: Nimbus Freight's tracking portal has been down since 06:00. Will the company email affected enterprise customers an incident notice before noon?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES only if the persistent event history shows that Nimbus Freight actually sent an incident notice email to affected enterprise customers before 2026-08-21T12:00:00+02:00. Otherwise resolve NO at the cutoff.
